授業科目の概要.講義題目:
Public Sector Policy Responses to Inequality and Poverty
（格差・貧困問題に対する公共部門の政策対応）

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業では、公共経済学や教育経済学の分野の実証研究の中で、特に格差・貧困・教育問題に関係するトピックを扱った研究をピックアップし、ゼミ形式でプレゼンテーションならびにディスカッションを行う。発表担当者は、事前に発表資料を作成することが必要となる。授業は基本的に英語で行われる。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course will learn specialized knowledge on the economic analyses of public economics, using Handbook of Economics of Education, Handbook of Income Distribution and related researches.
These volumes of the Handbook mainly cover various researches which examine the extent, causes, and consequences of inequality, poverty and educational outcomes.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Public economics, Economics of Education, Poverty, Well-being

授業科目の実施方法について.テキスト:
.The instructor will preselect approximately ten outstanding papers in economics addressing issues of inequality, poverty, and education. Participants will form groups of two to three members, and each group will present on a paper of their choosing from the assigned readings, followed by a general discussion.
Each participant is required to present twice over the course of the semester. In addition, second-year master's students will be asked to give one presentation on their master's thesis research plan, and doctoral students will be asked to present on their own research once.

Hanushek, E. A., Machin, S. J., and Woessmann, L. [Eds] (2016) Handbook of Economics of Education, Volume 5.
Eric Hanushek, Stephen Machin, and Ludger Woessmann [Eds] (2023)
Handbook of Economics of Education, Volume 7.
